subject: Trial playbook + competitive orchestration — next steps and test owners
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Trial playbook + competitive orchestration — next steps and test owners

Hi Maria — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed plan so the internal and external teams are aligned.

Recap of discovery highlights:
- Primary goal: quantify latency and cost per-effective-response vs Cloud A (hyperscaler-managed endpoints) across our 3 representative prompts.
- Success criteria: 95th percentile generation latency < 450ms for short prompts, cost delta < 30% vs Cloud A for production batch sizes, and parity on answer relevance as measured by the provided prompt-set evaluation.
- Data constraints: no customer PII in the trial dataset; CloudWave will provide anonymized prompts and an example traffic trace.

Proposed trial playbook (high level):
1) Baseline runs (Days 1–2): reproduce CloudWave's short/medium/long prompt runs on Redwood hosted inference; capture token-level latency and cost. Owner: Karthik Iyer.
2) Variant runs (Days 3–4): enable Redwood batching + KV prefix cache and run identical workload; measure tail latency improvements. Owner: Marissa Cole.
3) Failure/integration tests (Day 5): region-fallback and autoscale stress to validate graceful degradation. Owner: Hannah Schmitt.
4) Evaluation (Days 6–7): automated scoring against CloudWave's relevance labels + human spot checks. Owner: CloudWave (you) with Redwood QA support.

Attachments I will share: trial-playbook-v1.xlsx (timeline + owner matrix), cw-test-matrix.csv (exact inputs), sample-kpi-prompts.jsonl (anonymized prompt samples), and a short Redwood competitive one-pager.

Questions / asks for you before we lock the dates:
- Confirm the anonymized prompt file will be available by EOD Thursday (Dec 9).
- Any constraints on IP/evidence sharing for the final public-facing benchmark? (we can redact customer identifiers)
- Preferred day/time for an initial run kickoff — we suggested next Monday morning in the call.

If that all looks good I’ll upload the playbook and create the HubSpot trial record and DocuSign SOW for the reserved evaluation window we discussed.

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudwave.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWave Eval Admin <eval-admin@cloudwave.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial playbook + competitive orchestration — next steps and test owners

Thanks Hannah — appreciate the clear write up. A few quick answers and a request from our side: 

- We can provide the anonymized prompt set by EOD Thursday (Dec 9). I’ll attach the traffic trace to the HubSpot file once it’s exported.
- CloudWave is comfortable with Redwood publishing a redacted summary of the comparative results (no customer PII, and we’ll sign an NDA addendum if needed).
- Kickoff: Monday Dec 13, 09:00 PT works for our infra team. Please confirm your timezone and dial-in.

Request: can you add a simple "cost-per-1000-responses" calculation to the test matrix so we can directly compare economics? Also — our procurement team needs an initial SOW or trial terms doc to start internal approval.

For context, our evaluation team will also run a parallel baseline with two hyperscaler endpoints (Cloud A and Cloud B) and share their raw logs. Can Redwood ingest the same log format? If not, we’ll export CSV.

On the NDA: I’ll have legal loop in if we publish anything beyond the redacted summary, but the push to get the SOW started is top priority.

— Maria
Senior PM, CloudWave Systems
maria.lopez@cloudwave.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 07:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial playbook + competitive orchestration — next steps and test owners

Great — thanks Maria, that timeline works. Action items I’m taking now: 

- Uploading attachments to Drive: trial-playbook-v1.xlsx (owners/timeline), cw-test-matrix.csv (with a cost-per-1k-responses column added), sample-kpi-prompts.jsonl. Link in HubSpot record. Owner: Hannah (shipping today).
- SOW draft: I’ll circulate a short trial SOW (one page) for procurement to review. Owner: Marissa (will draft and share DocuSign).
- Log ingestion: Karthik confirmed we can accept CSV exports and have a small parser ready; asking for the sample trace so we can validate mapping. Owner: Karthik.
- Kickoff call: Monday Dec 13, 09:00 PT. I’ll create calendar invite and include a brief run-of-show (20m baseline, 30m instrumented runs, 10m Q&A).

Success criteria (proposed, for sign-off):
- Latency: 95th percentile under 450ms for short prompts on Redwood dedicated config.
- Cost: cost-per-1k-responses delta <= 30% vs Cloud A baseline.
- Quality: automated F1 >= baseline on CloudWave labels; no critical regressions detected in human spot checks.

I attached the playbook and the test matrix to the HubSpot record and shared a Drive link. Please let us know if your infra team prefers a different log format.

Attachments referenced: trial-playbook-v1.xlsx, cw-test-matrix.csv, sample-kpi-prompts.jsonl, redwood-competitive-one-pager.pdf

Onwards — I’ll follow up with the DocuSign SOW once Marissa has the draft.

Best,
Hannah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@cloudwave.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trial playbook + competitive orchestration — next steps and test owners

Adding the SOW and DocuSign tasks to my queue. I’ll draft a concise trial SOW (SLA-lite) that covers the reserved window, data handling (no PII), and permitted publication of redacted results. Expect a DocuSign link by EOD Friday.

Operational note for Redwood team: Karthik — please prep a lightweight runbook for the kickoff (shell commands, env vars, where logs will land). I’ll own the orchestration and check the autoscale policy used during the stress test.

Maria — calendar invite forthcoming from Hannah — please accept if the infra folks can make it. Looking forward to running this — we’ll aim to keep the trial reproducible for your procurement/engineering review.

Thanks — Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
